Returns a list of Varsel objects for the logged-in user that are unread and have bjelle set to true.

Forbidden. Returned when the user is not logged in or does not have access to the requested resource. This can occur if innloggingService.hentAvtalepart throws a TilgangskontrollException or FeilkodeException with UGYLDIG_KOMBINASJON_AV_ISSUER_OG_ROLLE or MANGLER_AD_GRUPPE_BESLUTTER.
Bad Request. Returned when a FeilkodeException is thrown, for example if the user is not logged in or has an invalid combination of issuer and role.

parameters.name: avtaleId
parameters.description: The ID of the avtale (agreement) to fetch notifications for.

responses.description: Returns a list of Varsel objects that are unread, have bjelle set to true, belong to the specified avtaleId, and have an identifikator matching any of the logged-in user's identifiers.

Bad Request. Returned when the innlogget-part cookie contains an invalid role or when the combination of issuer and role is invalid, as thrown by InnloggingService.hentAvtalepart (FeilkodeException with Feilkode.UGYLDIG_KOMBINASJON_AV_ISSUER_OG_ROLLE). Also returned when the user is not logged in (TilgangskontrollException with message 'Bruker er ikke innlogget.').
Forbidden. Returned when the logged-in user does not have the required AD group for the BESLUTTER role (FeilkodeException with Feilkode.MANGLER_AD_GRUPPE_BESLUTTER).
